description: READ-ONLY: your WHOLE relationship with one counterparty in a single view — the "should I deal with this address?" read. Composes: `trust` (the same two lenses as lawbor_vet — local conserved history + MainStreet oracle, never merged); `jobs` (every negotiation you both took part in — as requester/worker or seller/buyer — with its state, agreedPrice, award and settled flag); and `threads` (your conversations with them). Where lawbor_vet answers "can I trust them?", lawbor_peer answers "what is everything between us, right now?" — so an agent can decide and act on one call. Advisory: it gates nothing. Input: of (0x address).
name: lawbor_peer
